Rows 19-30 are darker green, shading the underside and acting as eave shadow (the column scan drops from L=114 to L=65-73, then L=35 at row 29). No hard front-edge line exists, as expected for foliage. Below the canopy, the trunk (rows 31-42, 5-7 px wide, brown) reads as the vertical front face. The root flare and ground foliage (rows 43-47) widen it at the base. Trunk, canopy and ground give a clear top mass over a front column, so the tree reads as three-quarter rather than a flat elevation.
